attchmntText: Capital Trust Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Capital Trust Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 on 14th November 2026. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, profit before tax was 17.08 lakhs and profit for the period was 25.95 lakhs. Earnings per share was 0.08 rupees. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, profit before tax was 28.51 lakhs and profit for the period was 46.13 lakhs. Earnings per share was 0.14 rupees. Total assets as at 30th September 2026 stood at 10,929.34 lakhs. Total equity was 6,194.79 lakhs. Cash and cash equivalents were 650.35 lakhs. Net cash generated from operating activities for the half year was 478.74 lakhs. The company transferred loans worth 119.63 lakhs through direct assignment during the quarter.

attchmntText: Capital Trust Limited has informed the Exchange regarding change in Registered Office of the company.
